t: Is Park Hotels & Resorts a Buy? | The Motley Fool
s: July 22, 2020 - Real estate investment trusts (REITs) are structured to create income for investors, but Park Hotels & Resorts (PK 1.57%) stopped paying a dividend. Income-focused investors should clearly avoid the stock at this point -- but could there be an opportunity for more aggressive investors to play a turnaround here? Indeed, with shares down by nearly two-thirds in 2020, there's probably material recovery potential, but only if you can handle the risk. The core of any real estate investment trust is the properties it owns. Park Hotels & Resorts owns, as its name implies, around 60 hotels and resorts.
